confirm_publish: Reply YES to publish, NO to cancel.
confirm_change: Reply YES to confirm, NO to cancel.
confirm_delete: Reply YES to remove, NO to cancel.
confirm_low_confidence: Just to double-check — did you mean: {summary}? Reply 'yes' or tell me what to change.
confirm_no_pending_intent: Sorry, something went wrong with that request — please send it again.
generic_error: Something went wrong on our end — nothing was published. Want to try again?
generic_error_with_reason: Something went wrong: {error}. Nothing was published. Want to try again?
undo_generic_error: Something went wrong while trying to undo that change — nothing was reverted. Please try again.
undo_done_with_url: Done — your last change has been reverted. Here's the live state: {url}.
undo_done: Done — your last change has been reverted.
completion_with_url: Done! Here's the live change: {url}. You can undo this within 24h by replying UNDO.
completion: Done! The change is live. You can undo this within 24h by replying UNDO.
voice_echo: I heard: "{transcript}" — is that right? Reply yes to continue, or send the correct version as text.
voice_echo_low_confidence: (I'm not fully sure I heard that correctly) I heard: "{transcript}" — is that right? Reply yes to continue, or send the correct version as text.
fallback_reply: Sorry — I couldn't make out your voice message. Could you try sending it again, or type your request as a text message?
confirmation_reask: Sorry, should I go ahead? Reply yes or no.
confirmation_cancelled: Okay, the request has been cancelled. You can re-send it anytime.
no_intent_question: Sorry — I couldn't quite understand your request. You can ask me to post a job, add an announcement, or update your business info like hours, contact, address, or prices. Could you rephrase it?
still_unsure: I'm having trouble understanding what you'd like to change. Could you text me the request in one message, for example: "post a job for a part-time barista" or "change my hours to 9-6"?
field_job_remote: Is the role remote, on-site, or hybrid?
field_announcement_title: What should the announcement be titled?
field_image_slot: Where should the image go — homepage banner, logo, or gallery?
field_image_media_url: Please send the image you'd like to use.
field_business_info_phone: What phone number should I update to?
field_business_info_hours: What are the new opening hours?
field_page_title: Which page do you want to update — About, Home, or something else?
field_page_content: What should the page content say?
onboard_step_url: Let's connect your website so you can update it by WhatsApp. Step 1 — send me your site URL, for example https://mybusiness.com
onboard_step_username: Got it — {url}. Step 2 — send the WordPress username of the user I'll use (it needs the Editor role). Don't have one? In WordPress: Users → Add New → role: Editor.
onboard_step_app_password: Step 3 — send the application password for that user. To create one: WordPress → Users → Profile → Application Passwords → name it 'wp-bot' → Add New, then copy the password (it's only shown once).
onboard_success: You're all set — {url} is connected and ready. Try asking me: "Post a job: part-time barista, $18/hr", "Add an announcement: closed July 4th", or "Change my hours to 9-6". I'll always confirm with you before anything goes live.
onboard_invalid_url: That doesn't look like a website address. Send your full URL, for example https://mybusiness.com
onboard_unreachable: I couldn't reach {url}. Check that the site is online and the address is correct, then send it again.
onboard_not_wordpress: That site is online, but I couldn't find WordPress on it. Only WordPress sites can be connected — double-check the address and send it again.
onboard_invalid_credentials: WordPress rejected the application password. It's created at WordPress → Users → Profile → Application Passwords (copy it right away — it's only shown once). Send the application password again.
onboard_insufficient_permissions: The login works, but that WordPress user can't edit posts. The user needs the Editor role (WordPress → Users, edit the user). Send the username and application password of an Editor-level user.
onboard_cancelled: No problem — setup cancelled. Message me 'set up my website' anytime to connect your site.
site_list_empty: You don't have any sites connected yet. Message me 'set up my website' to get started.
site_list_hint: To switch sites, say 'switch to' followed by the site URL or id.
site_not_found: I couldn't find a site matching '{target}'. Your sites are: {sites}. Try 'list sites' to see all options.
site_switched: Switched to {url}. What would you like to update?
site_list_error: Sorry, I couldn't retrieve your sites right now. Please try again.
compose_image_create: Set your {slot} to the photo you sent. {confirm}
compose_image_replace: Replace your {slot} with the photo you sent. {confirm}
recap_empty: No changes recorded yet. Send a message to update your site.
